your post is somewhat incoherent ... you ask what would be required to create a universal, officially supported Linux installation system for phones? and then you proceed to ask guessing questions that would be answered when the first question is answered

Q: I want to use my existing, live 'X' Meta App to post to the 'Y' pages via the Graph API A:

You get a page access token, by letting a page admin log in to your app and granting it the relevant permissions.

Whether that will be possible with the current state of your app, you'll have to test and see. It might well be that due to missing business validation, they won't let regular users log in to your app.

Q: Error When Using COALESCE to Handle `NULL` Values in Apache IoTDB A:

I think you can cast the literal to FLOAT

SELECT avg(coalesce(temperature, CAST(0.0 AS FLOAT))) FROM testdata;

If this still has issues, try:

SELECT avg(CAST(coalesce(temperature, 0.0) AS FLOAT)) FROM testdata;

This approach is often more compatible across different SQL engines
Actually, most aggregate functions in IoTDB (including AVG) naturally skip NULL values. So you might consider:

-- Calculate average excluding NULLs
SELECT avg(temperature) FROM testdata;
-- Result: (20.0 + 25.0) / 2 = 22.5

if you truly want NULLS to count as 0 in the average

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN temperature IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE temperature END) / count(*) 
FROM testdata;
-- Result: (20.0 + 0.0 + 0.0 + 25.0) / 4 = 11.25

Why Your Attempts Failed
1. **`0.0` alone**: IoTDB treats this as DOUBLE, not FLOAT
2. **`0.0F` syntax**: IoTDB doesn't support the F suffix for float literals (unlike Java)
3. **CAST without closing parenthesis**: Your third attempt was missing a closing parenthesis

Q: node module not found .MODULE NOT FOUND A:

I think the error is caused by the node_modules directory. In my case, I tried npm install with an old version of node(nodev12) for an app using nodev18. After I deleted nodev12, I also removed the node_modelues directory and ran npm install and it worked.
